segments.title: 第157章 為你寫的歌
segments.content:
Chapter 157: A Song Written for You

"What kind of person is Auntie Yuan usually?"

During dinner, Li Luo asked Yan Zhusheng, who was beside him.

Because of the math competition, Ying Chanxi hardly ate with them anymore; she was still in class at this time.

So, only Li Luo and Yan Zhusheng were at the dinner table.

Since he was going to attend an interview with Yuan Wanqing over the weekend, Li Luo thought it would be better to understand Yan Zhusheng's mother a bit more.

"My mom is a very nice person." Yan Zhusheng blinked, not understanding why Li Luo would suddenly ask this.

"I mean, does Auntie Yuan have any taboos? Topics others shouldn't bring up or touch upon."

Although he had met Yuan Wanqing a few times, it was always in the capacity of Yan Zhusheng's classmate, a meeting between a student and a classmate's parent.

Li Luo knew that in front of parents, he would more or less put on a deliberate disguise to make himself appear polite, simple, and harmless.

Conversely, parents also tended to be more reserved in front of their child's classmates, and would not completely reveal their true selves.

"Oh, so that's what you mean..." Yan Zhusheng seemed to have been hit with a key question. She suddenly fell silent, poking at her rice with her chopsticks.

"Uh... if it's inconvenient to talk about, then forget it."

Li Luo was actually a little unsure about the situation between Yan Zhusheng and Yuan Wanqing.

From the looks of it, Yuan Wanqing cared a lot about her daughter.

But in his past life, when Yan Zhusheng was in her thirties and living alone, Li Luo had worked for her for half a year and had never once seen her mother visit.

Of course, he wasn't living at Yan Zhusheng's place all day, so he couldn't be sure. It was just that he had never met Yuan Wanqing in his previous life, so he had little to go on.

"It's fine." Yan Zhusheng shook her head. "Just don't ask about my dad."

"Huh? What happened to your dad?"

"I don't know. He was gone when I was born."

"Oh... I'm sorry."

"Why are you apologizing?" Yan Zhusheng blinked, a little slow to react. "It's just that when I was little and asked my mom where my dad was, she always seemed a bit sad, so I'm just reminding you."

Perhaps because she had never experienced having a father since birth, and was always by Yuan Wanqing's side, living abroad for a long time, Yan Zhusheng had simply never developed feelings for that part of her life.

So much so that she didn't feel like she was missing anything, and thus couldn't understand why Li Luo was apologizing.

"So, what was it like with your mom when you were abroad?"

"Abroad?" Yan Zhusheng recalled for a moment. "Nothing particularly special."

"Mom often needed treatment. Other than that, she'd be at home recuperating, and we had to go for a walk every day."

"A teacher would come to our house to teach me every day, but usually, I only had to study in the mornings."

"In the afternoon, Mom would play all kinds of musical instruments with me. Whatever I wanted to learn, she would teach me."

Li Luo listened intently. These were all things he had never heard in his past life.

After all, in his last life, it was a relationship between a boss and an employee. Even after they became familiar with each other, it was impossible to bare one's soul and share stories from one's childhood.

The thirty-year-old Yan Zhusheng was, after all, different from the sixteen-year-old Yan Zhusheng.

And after hearing Yan Zhusheng's account, Li Luo finally understood.

No wonder this girl always spoke so bluntly. It turned out she had very little social contact growing up.

It was perfectly normal that she didn't know how to say the right things.

After dinner, the two of them walked out of the cafeteria together and headed straight for the activity room on the second floor of the gym.

Niu Qingling had given Yan Zhusheng the key before, so when they arrived, they unlocked the door and went straight in.

The others hadn't arrived yet. Li Luo walked directly to a corner, picked up a guitar, sat on a high stool, and began to play softly.

"What's this song?" Yan Zhusheng tilted her head and listened carefully. "I don't think I've heard it before."

"If you haven't heard it, then write down the sheet music." Li Luo smiled at her.

"A new song?" Yan Zhusheng's eyes lit up, surprised that Li Luo had a new song after just over a month.

"I think it should suit you well." Li Luo said, continuing to play and humming softly.

"The sky has no limits"

"My future is boundless"

"Breaking from my chrysalis, I will fly toward a bluer tomorrow"

When Niu Qingling and the others walked into the activity room, they heard Li Luo singing the climax of the chorus. They froze for a moment and stopped in their tracks.

Shao Youpeng was following behind and nearly bumped into her. "President, what are you doing? You scared me by stopping so suddenly."

"Listen to Li Luo sing." Niu Qingling pointed into the room. "I've never heard this song. Have you?"

"Never heard it."

"It couldn't be like the last time at the sports meet, could it?" Xie Shuchen, who was behind them, couldn't help but click his tongue. "I heard from the people in Class 8 that the song Li Luo sang alone on the rostrum last time was one he wrote himself."

"Is this another new song?" Niu Qingling was a little surprised. She couldn't help but move closer to Yan Zhusheng and saw that she had already written down the melody.

"Mhm." Yan Zhusheng nodded, had Li Luo play it again to confirm her sheet music was correct, and then had him write down the corresponding lyrics.

"I was thinking, aren't we supposed to discuss what song to perform for the New Year's Gala today?" Li Luo smiled and pointed at the sheet music in his hand. "President, will this song do?"

"Can you sing it again?" Niu Qingling asked. "Let's listen from the beginning."

Just then, another person walked in through the door.

Hearing the noise, everyone turned to look and saw that it was the former sophomore keyboardist, Qian Siliang.

"Uh, President, hello everyone." Qian Siliang greeted them a little sheepishly.

Niu Qingling nodded at him. "You're here."

"You still know the way back?" Shao Youpeng chuckled. "Aren't you ashamed of letting a junior temporarily take your place?"

"I was too busy with the competition back then." Qian Siliang said helplessly. "But I'm back now, I apologize to you all."

"Are you done with the competition now?"

"My preliminary results were too poor, couldn't pass." Qian Siliang shrugged. "Too many freaks out there. I have no idea how they solve those kinds of problems."

"What about Wei Duo?"

"About the same as me, not much better anyway."

"Then why isn't she here?" Shao Youpeng pressed curiously. "You're in the same class as her, right?"

"What else could it be." Qian Siliang glanced at Yan Zhusheng. "She's too embarrassed to come back."

"Got it. Not as thick-skinned as you."

"You son of a..."

The two of them joked and bantered for a bit. Qian Siliang apologized, and the matter was considered over.

However, everyone tacitly understood that Wei Duo probably wouldn't be coming back.

Whether she came back or not wasn't really important. After all, the rock club now had a top-tier lead singer in Yan Zhusheng. Even if Wei Duo did return, they wouldn't know how to place her.

With Qian Siliang back, however, the keyboardist position was filled, and Xie Shuchen could return to being a guitarist.

"Then I'm free?" Li Luo raised an eyebrow and asked happily.

"Two guitarists would be better," Yan Zhusheng said seriously. "Xie Shuchen can handle the main melody, and you can be responsible for the rhythm chords. That way, you'll also have more energy to back me up with harmonies."

Li Luo: "...You're really good at finding things for me to do."

"Excellent." Niu Qingling clapped her hands with a smile. "Then it's settled. Li Luo, you sing your new song first."

"Alright."

Li Luo strummed the guitar strings a few times and then sang "The Sky Has No Limits" again.

After listening, the others fell into thought.

"The song is really good, but is it okay to perform a new song directly?" Qian Siliang asked, rubbing his chin. "After all, the other students haven't heard it."

"That doesn't matter, as long as it's hype," Niu Qingling said. "But I feel like the singing is lacking something."

"That's because I was the one singing just now." Li Luo coughed twice, then looked at Yan Zhusheng. "Have you memorized the chorus melody? Sing a few lines for us."

Seeing Yan Zhusheng nod, Li Luo strummed the strings and cut straight to the chorus.

In the next second, Yan Zhusheng's explosive high notes erupted in the small activity room.

The same line, "The sky has no limits," sung by Yan Zhusheng, made Xie Shuchen and the others feel as if they were instantly high up in the sky, as if they had broken through the firmament itself, their bodies and souls floating lightly.

In comparison, although Li Luo's singing was also pleasant, it was simply no match for Yan Zhusheng's.

After hearing Yan Zhusheng sing the entire chorus, Niu Qingling no longer hesitated and made the decision on the spot: "This is the one! With Zhusheng, there's no problem at all!"

After the evening club activities ended.

Li Luo and Yan Zhusheng were walking back to their classroom.

Yan Zhusheng was still holding the notebook with the sheet music, upon which Li Luo's lyrics were written.

"When I curiously hammered on the black and white keys"

"When I hid in my room, performing with ecstatic abandon"

"You never once extinguished my innocent flame"

"Never blaming me for wasting time"

Yan Zhusheng hummed as she savored the meaning of the lyrics, her eyes glancing at Li Luo beside her. Her steps were light, and her heart was filled with joy.

She thought, she must sing this song for her mother.

Her mother would definitely love this song, just like she did.

"Li Luo, you didn't just come up with this song on the spot, did you?" Yan Zhusheng asked curiously.

"Of course not," Li Luo said. "The you from fifteen years in the future sent it to me in a dream."

(End of Chapter)
